newsitem.title: USA: Wausau to spend $8 mln on mill improvment.
newsitem.headline: Wausau to spend $8 mln on mill improvment.

text.p: Wausau Paper Mills Co said Monday its board of directors has approved more than $8 million in capital investments to expand capacity at its Groveton, New Hampshire mill.
The capital projects, to be completed over the next two years, will expand printing and writing paper capacity by five percent at the mill, the company said.
The projects include replacing the electric dive on one paper machine and making upgrades to the wet end and dryer systems on another machine.
Wausau shares were down 3/16 at 19-5/16 Monday.
